conf.comment: arcsight-esm / correlation-events / csv-file. Per recommendations.direct.cribl: 'High-side instance, no guard: pass through and instrument rather than parse, the same stance as the CEF route... leave the CSV parse to the Elastic side.' Two further instructions in that recommendation are NOT implemented as pipeline functions: (1) a per-(rule name, hour) reconciliation counter, which is a cross-event aggregation/metrics concern, not a per-event Processing Pipeline transform; (2) suppressing forwarded correlated base events, which needs a field flagging the 'correlated' annotation that this work order's field list does not supply -- guessing that field name is exactly what the brief prohibits. Both are recorded as gaps in README.md rather than guessed or half-implemented.
